source: 613 New Commission
target: 613 Nova Commissio

source: A few days later, Lumian lounged on a recliner on the suite’s balcony, soaking in the sea breeze, reveling in the sunlight, and sipping an undiluted Manzan.
target: Paucis diebus postea, Lumian in solio reclinato in balcone suitei iacebat, fruens aura maris, radiis solis delectatus, et Manzan non dilutum sorbens.

source: From his Traveler’s Bag, he retrieved the incomplete umbilical cord from Father Montserrat.
target: Ex sacculo viatoris, funem umbilicalem imperfectum a Patre Montserrat extraxit.

source: The cord was completely charred, stripped of its spirituality.
target: Funis umbilicalis omnino combustus erat, spiritualitate carens.

source: After Lumian’s repeated confirmations, backed by Franca and Jenna’s divination, a conclusion was reached:
target: Post confirmationes repetitas Lumiani, divinatione Francae et Jennae innitens, conclusio evenerat:

source: After the Exorcism Spell, the umbilical cord lost its vitality.
target: Post incantationem exorcismi, funis umbilicalis vitalitatem amisit.

source: Moreover, lacking Beyonder characteristics, it couldn’t function as a mystical item or a main ingredient for charms, agents, weapons, or any other artifacts.
target: Praeterea, proprietatibus Beyonder carens, non potuit fungor ut res mystica aut ut elementum principale ad incantamenta, agentes, arma, aut alias res artificiosas.

source: All it retained now was its distinct uniqueness.
target: Omnia quae nunc retinebat, singularitas distincta eius erant.

source: In simpler terms, it mirrored the mark left on Lumian by Blood Emperor Alista Tudor.
target: Simplius dictu, repraesentabat notam, quam Blood Emperor Alista Tudor in Lumiano reliquit.

source: Devoid of power and incapable of emitting the fearsome aura of the Great Mother’s Child of God, Lumian couldn’t wield it to intimidate a specific target.
target: Potentia carens et incapax efferendi terribilem aurem Magnae Matris Filii Dei, Lumian id uti non potuit ad aliquem scopus metu imponendum.

source: Lumian surmised that it could only play a role in two scenarios.
target: Lumian suspicatus est id solum in duobus casibus munus habere posse.

source: Firstly, it could act as a casting ingredient, enabling specific spells to wield power beyond ordinary standards or aiding Warlocks in utilizing special spells beyond their usual repertoire.
target: Primum, poterat fungor ut elementum incantandi, permittens incantationibus certis vim ultra limites ordinarios gerere, aut Warlockis auxiliandum ut incantationes speciales extra consuetudinem suam adhiberent.

source: Secondly, it could serve as a supplementary ingredient incorporated during the crafting of mystical items, charms, agents, or Beyonder weapons, imparting unique effects to the final product.
target: Secundo, poterat fungor ut elementum supplementarium incorporatum in fabricando rebus mysticis, amuletis, agentibus, armis, aut alias artefactis Beyonder, singularia effecta producto finali tradens.

source: Naturally, Lumian also believed that such an umbilical cord fragment could prove valuable in the presence of the Great Mother’s bestowed.
target: Naturaliter, Lumian etiam credidit talem fragmentum funis umbilicalis in praesentia dona Magnae Matris valde utile fore.

source: For instance, even without Provocation, he could provoke intense animosity from those individuals.
target: Exempli gratia, etiam sine Provocatione, poterat ab illis hominibus vehementem invidiam excitare.

source: Regrettably, Witches share similarities with Pyromaniacs.
target: Infeliciter, magae similes sunt pyromaniacis.

source: They are restricted to utilizing various black magic bestowed by potions, unable to delve into spell study and master new incantations like Warlocks.
target: Solum variis magiis nigris, potionibus donatis, utuntur et incantationum studium penetrare nec novas incantationes, ut Warlocki, magistrari possunt.

source: Among these black magics, only one, the Bloodline Curse, can be paired with an umbilical cord as a casting ingredient.
target: Inter has magias nigras, sola una, Maledictio Sanguinis, cum funi umbilicali ut elementum incantandi coniungi potest.

source: However, the invisible Child of God has yet to manifest in the real world, rendering the curse ineffective against Him.
target: Attamen, invisibilis Filius Dei nondum in mundo reali apparuit, unde maledictio adversus Eum inefficax manet.

source: Cursing the Great Mother is also off the table, as Franca and Jenna might find themselves with giving birth right there and then…
target: Maledicere Magnam Matrem quoque excluditur, cum Franca et Jenna fortasse statim se in partu inveniant…

source: Yes, at the next meeting at the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society or any other mysticism gathering, I could aim to acquire a mystical item tied to a Warlock Sequence, then amass potent spells that employ umbilical cords or high-level items as casting ingredients.
target: Ita, in proximo conventu apud “Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society” aut in alio coetu mystico, poteram conari rem mysticam, conexam cum Serie Warlock, adipisci, atque incantationes potentes, quae funibus umbilicalibus aut rebus summi gradus ut elementum incantandi adhibeantur, colligere.

source: Uh… isn’t this creating several complications?
target: Heu... nonne hoc complura incommoda creat?

source: In Aurore’s terms, it’s akin to raising a sheep for a plate of coarse salt—nurturing it only to be eventually slaughtered and roasted…
target: Ex loquela Aurore, simile est ovem nutrire ad mensam salis grossi, sed quae, postquam colata est, tandem trucidata et tosta fiat…

source: I’ve not needed to seek out an Artisan for crafting mystical items lately, and the absence of primary ingredients complicates matters.
target: Nuper non opus fuit mihi artifex quaerere ad res mysticas conficiendas, et defectus ingredientium principalium res complicat.

source: Alternatively, should I transform it into a Beyonder weapon with limited use?
target: Aliter, an id in armum Beyonder in usum limitatum convertere debeam?

source: This isn’t ideal.
target: Hoc non est optimum.

source: There’s a contamination risk if an insufficiently skilled Artisan incorporates it as a supplementary ingredient.
target: Periculum contaminationis exsistit, si artifex parum peritus id ut elementum supplementarium incorporaverit.

source: It’s not worthwhile enlisting the help of a high-level Artisan for what seems like a practically useless item…
target: Non est utile auxilium artificis summi gradus capere pro re quae fere inutilis videtur.

source: What about fashioning charms and agents myself?
target: Quid de ipsis amuletis et agentibus a me conficiendis?

source: Lumian scrutinized the charred short umbilical cord for an extended period, grappling with indecision.
target: Lumian funem umbilicalem exustum, brevem, diu perscrutatus est, indecisione luctans.

source: Eventually, he returned it to his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Postremo, id in sacculo viatoris sui retribuit.

source: Then, Lumian reached into his pocket, where a finger from Mr. K sat.
target: Tum, Lumian in sinum suum immisit, ubi digitus a Domino K sedebat.

source: In the past two days, he had undertaken a special “return” to Trier to brief Mr. K about Father Montserrat and the invisible Child of God.
target: In duobus diebus praeteritis, iter speciale ad Trier cepit, ut Domino K de Patre Montserrat et invisibili Filio Dei exponeret.

source: He received unreserved approval and praise from Mr. K.
target: Accepit approbationem sincera et laudes a Domino K.

source: The enthusiasm and fervor led Lumian to suspect that Mr. K might, in the next moment, sever his own arm and offer it to him.
target: Laetitia et fervor Lumiani duciverunt ut suspiceret Domini K, in proximo momento, brachium suum abscindere atque illi offerre posse.

source: His fingers seemed insufficient to convey the depth of his emotions!
target: Digiti eius videbantur insufficientes ad profunditatem affectuum eius exponendam!

source: Mr. K expressed great satisfaction with his decision to permit Lumian to leave Trier and pursue his adversaries.
target: Dominus K magnam satisfactionem de sua decisione expressit, qua Lumian Trier relinquere et adversarios persequi licuit.

source: He perceived it as the Lord’s revelation and commended Lumian’s peculiar affinity for heretics and incidents involving evil gods, seeing him as a walking calamity for the fallen.
target: Id perspexit ut revelationem Domini et laudavit singularem affectionem Lumiani erga haereticos atque casus deorum malignorum, eumque tamquam calamitatem ambulantem pro lapsis considerans.

source: How could a Beyonder of such stature confine himself to Trier?
target: Quomodo Beyonder tali statura se in Trier tenere potuit?

source: It was imperative to explore various locations in the Northern and Southern Continents!
target: Necesse erat loca varia explorare in Continente Septentrionali et Meridionali!

source: Regarding the name of the ancient Goddess of Harvest, Omebella, Mr. K didn’t exhibit a notable reaction, nor did he seek an immediate revelation from his Lord.
target: Quoad nomen deae antiquitatis Messis, Omebella, Dominus K responsum notabilem non exhibuit neque revelationem immediatam a Domino petivit.

source: Lumian, failing to secure an answer, bid farewell and departed.
target: Lumian, responsum non obtinens, vale dixit et discessit.

source: Instead, he sought out Franca, Jenna, and Anthony to share the details of the surgical removal, human refinement, and Father Montserrat’s near‐conception of the Great Mother’s Child of God as a man.
target: Pro illis, Francam, Jennam, et Antonium quaesivit ut enarraret singula de excisione chirurgica, de emendatione humana, atque de prope conceptione Filii Dei Magnae Matris ut hominis ex Patre Montserrat.

source: While Franca and Jenna were already acquainted with the Sowers of the Villain pathway, the connection with Father Montserrat left them feeling like they were hearing a horror story, traumatized by the bestowed of the Great Mother.
target: Dum Franca et Jenna iam iter Sementariorum Malefactorum noverant, coniunctio cum Patre Montserrat eos reliquit quasi fabulam horroris audire, a dono Magnae Matris traumatizatos.

source: Anthony displayed no overt reaction, but he made a rare gesture.
target: Antonius nullam reactionem manifestae exhibuit, sed rarum gestum effecit.

source: Unconsciously, he gently stroked his stomach.
target: Inconscius, leniter ventrem suum tetigit.

source: After conveying his sentiments, Lumian returned to the ship contentedly, resuming his journey to the southernmost part of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
target: Postquam sensus suos transmisit, Lumian in nave laetus rediit, iter ad meridionalissimam partem regni Feynapotter repetens.

source: Knock, knock, knock.
target: Toc, toc, toc.

source: Lumian had just flipped through the Dutanese textbook for a few minutes when a series of knocks echoed on the suite’s wooden door.
target: Lumian vix librum Dutanensem per paucos minutas percurrebat, cum serie pulsuum in ostium ligneum suitei resonare coepit.

source: Lugano, ever diligent, played the role of a servant, making his way to the door and peering through the peephole.
target: Lugano, semper diligens, munus servi egit; ad ianuam processit et per speculum parvum intueri coepit.

source: In the past few days, the absence of baby cries had eased his anxious heart.
target: In paucis diebus praeteritis, absentia clamorum parvulorum cor eius anxium levaverat.

source: This incident only heightened his gratitude for choosing to stay with his employer rather than returning to Trier.
target: Hoc factum gratiam eius tantopere auxit, quod cum domino suo manere potuit, potius quam ad Trier redire.

source: Lugano believed that if the issue stemmed from the Beyonder ingredients left behind by Tanko, even if he hadn’t boarded this ship, he would have encountered a similar situation sooner or later.
target: Lugano credidit, si quaestio ex ingredientibus Beyonder a Tanko relictis oriretur, etiam si hanc navem non conscenderet, similem condicionem aliquando experiturum fuisse.

source: Moreover, the wait wouldn’t be long — perhaps a year or even half a year.
target: Praeterea, exspectatio non diu manebit — fortasse annus aut etiam dimidium anni.

source: Without the aid of a powerful Beyonder like Lumian Lee, his fate would have been quite clear.
target: Sine auxilio Beyonder potentis, ut Lumian Lee, fatum eius perspicuus fuisset.

source: Spotting Captain Pedro outside, Lugano turned to Lumian, who was on the balcony, and informed him, "Boss, the captain is looking for you!"
target: Viderunt Capitanum Pedrum extra, Lugano ad Lumian, qui in balcone erat, conversus est, et ei dixit: "Domine, capitanus te quaerit!"

source: Why would the captain seek me out?
target: Cur capitanus me quaereret?

source: Shouldn’t we tacitly overlook what happened?
target: Num id, quod accidit, non tacite praetermittere deberemus?

source: Lumian closed the Dutanese textbook and returned to the living room, bathed in bright sunlight.
target: Lumian librum Dutanensem clausit et ad conclave rediit, in luce solis fulgenti.

source: Pedro, sporting a handsome brown beard, entered the suite and exchanged pleasantries.
target: Pedro, cum barba brunnea decora gerens, in suite intravit et verba amicitiae commutavit.

source: Clearing his throat, he said, "Mr. Berry, are you interested in taking on a commission? It’s a straightforward one and won’t consume much of your time."
target: Gutture purgato, dixit: "Domine Berry, an commissionem suscipere vis? Ea simplex est et non multum temporis consumet."

source: Straightforward? I doubt it would remain so after being entrusted to me…
target: Simplex? Dubito quin ita maneat postquam mihi commissum fuerit…

source: After various experiences, he gained a better understanding of his unique constitution: As a Beyonder of the Hunter pathway, harboring an evil god’s angel within him and concealed remnants of the Blood Emperor’s aura, he naturally attracted calamities, prematurely unveiling problems that might have remained hidden.
target: Post varias experientias, melius intellexit singularem constitutionem suam: ut Beyonder viae Venatoris, angelum dei mali intra se portans et reliquias occultas aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis, naturaliter calamitates attrahens, atque ante tempus problemata revelans quae fortasse latere potuerunt.

source: Lumian couldn’t foresee how a supposedly simple commission would unfold.
target: Lumian non potuit praevidere quomodo commissio, simplicis specie existens, evolveretur.

source: Seated in an armchair, Lumian smiled and responded, "What commission? I’ll listen to the specifics before deciding whether to accept it."
target: Sedeo in solio bracchato, Lumian subridens respondit: "Quae commissio? Specialia auscultabo antequam decernam utrum eam suscipiam."

source: Pedro sighed, beginning to explain, "The destination of this voyage is Port Colla, my hometown."
target: Pedro suspiravit et explanare coepit: "Destinatio huius peregrinationis est Portus Colla, oppidum meum natale."

source: My wife and children live there.
target: Uxor mea et liberi mei ibi habitant.

source: "At the start of the year, my beloved eldest daughter, Salah, fell in love with a young man."
target: "Initio anni, amata filia mea primogenita, Salah, in iuvenem amore cecidit."

source: "She was passionate and eager to marry him."
target: "Erat ardens et vehementer eum in matrimonium ducere cupiebat."

source: "As you’re aware, in Feynapotter, marriage and family are held in high regard."
target: "Ut nosti, in Feynapotter, matrimonium et familia magni aestimantur."

source: "We must approach marriage cautiously and maintain it responsibly."
target: "Matrimonium caute aggrediendum, et more responsabili conservandum, oportet."

source: "Blindly rushing into the cathedral isn’t our way."
target: "Caeca in catedrali festinatio non est via nostra."

source: "Is that lad displeasing to you and your Matriarch? Are you hiring me to silence him?" Lumian teased.
target: "Num ille puer tibi et matriarcha tua displicet? An me conducis ut eum silentiare faciam?" Lumian iocose replicavit.

source: "Honestly, there’s no need for such trouble."
target: "Sincere, talis molestia non est necessaria."

source: "A captain like you surely has plenty of ways to handle inexperienced young people."
target: "Capitano ut te, certe plures habes modos iuvenes inexpertos tractandi."

source: "For instance, give him an opportunity and entice him into the sea trade—only for him to never return."
target: "Exempli gratia, ei occasionem da et eum in mercaturam maritimam induc, ut numquam revertatur."

source: Pedro chuckled dryly and responded, "I’m a law-abiding citizen. I won’t resort to such measures."
target: Pedro sic subridens respondit: "Civis legibus obsequens sum. Non ad talia consilia recurram."

source: A sea-faring captain with Beyonder abilities is a law-abiding citizen? Spare me the humor…
target: Capitano maritimo cum facultatibus Beyonder, civis legibus obsequens? Noli mihi talia ioca afferre…

source: Lumian criticized, smiling at Pedro, prompting him to continue.
target: Lumian, ad Pedrum subridens reprehendens, eum ad prosequendum instigavit.

source: "I probed the young man and sensed something amiss."
target: "Puerum indagai et aliquid inordinatum sensi."

source: "I hired adventurers to investigate him, but the two adventurers never returned," Pedro explained earnestly.
target: "Conduxi adventuros ut eum indagarent, sed duo adventores numquam redierunt," Pedro sincere explicavit.

source: "This raised my alarm."
target: "Hoc me excitavit."

source: "I don’t want my child involved with such a person. It’s too risky."
target: "Nolo filium meum cum tali persona coniungi. Nimis periculosum est."

source: Lumian nodded slightly.
target: Lumian leviter annuit.

source: "Is that why you’ve sought me out?"
target: "Num ideo me quaesivisti?"

source: "Yes," Pedro admitted, forcing a smile.
target: "Ita," Pedro agnovit, subsurridens.

source: "To you, this may seem trivial, but it’s of utmost importance to me."
target: "Tibi fortasse parva videatur, sed mihi maximi momenti est."

source: "I’m willing to pay 20,000 gold risot as compensation."
target: "Paratus sum 20,000 risot aureorum ad compensationem solvendam."

source: "All spoils are yours."
target: "Omnia praeda tua erunt."

source: 20,000 gold risot.
target: 20,000 risot aureorum.

source: Being a captain seems quite lucrative…
target: Esse capitaneum videtur valde lucrativum…

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and asked, "Are you a Beyonder of the Planter or Apothecary pathway?"
target: Lumian paulo meditatus est et interrogavit: "Esne Beyonder viae Plantatoris aut Apothecarii?"

source: "Are there any Beyonders from these two pathways in your family?"
target: "Suntne Beyonder ex his duabus viis in familia tua?"

source: What kind of question is that…
target: "Qualis quaestio est ista…"

source: Pedro was taken aback.
target: Pedro obstupuit.

source: "No."
target: "Non."

source: "Why haven’t you sought help from the Church?" Lumian inquired, posing a second question.
target: "Cur auxilium Ecclesiae non petivisti?" Lumian interrogavit.

source: Pedro’s expression darkened.
target: Aspectus Pedri obscuratus est.

source: After a brief silence, he sighed and replied, "As expected of an experienced adventurer."
target: Post breve silentium, suspiravit et dixit: "Ut exspectabatur ab experto viatore."

source: "I didn’t approach the Church because something is off with my daughter, Salah."
target: "Non petivi Ecclesiam, quia in filia mea, Salah, aliquid male est."

source: "Her infatuation with that young man is too intense, and she rejects reason."
target: "Eius infatuatio erga illum iuvenem nimis intensa est, et rationem repellit."

source: "It’s as if she’s possessed by a demon."
target: "Sicut a daemone possessa sit."

source: "Seeking the Church could resolve the issue, but it might also lead to a negative encounter and outcome for Salah."
target: "Quaerere Ecclesiam quaestionem solvere posset, sed etiam ad infaustam congressionem et eventum pro Salah ducere posset."

source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
target: Lumian cogitanter annuit.

source: "Do you suspect that Salah has been influenced or even possessed by an unknown entity?"
target: "Suspicisne fortasse Salah a ente ignoto influentam esse aut possessa esse?"

source: "Yes," Pedro admitted, appearing worried.
target: "Ita," Pedro agnovit, sollicite se ostendens.

source: Lumian asked a few more questions and took a moment to reflect before stating, "Alright, I accept this commission."
target: Lumian pauca alia interrogavit et paulisper meditatus est, deinde dicens: "Recte, hanc commissionem accipio."

source: He had to consistently pursue opportunities and work towards digesting the Conspirer potion to a level where he could conduct an advancement ritual upon reaching West Balam in the Southern Continent.
target: Debebat constanter occasiones persequi et ad potionem Conspiratoris digerendam operam dare, ut gradum attingeret quo ritus progressionis celebrari posset, perveniens ad West Balam in Continente Meridionali.

source: Of course, saving up funds for Ludwig’s meals was another motivation.
target: Certe, pecuniam ad cibos Ludovigi servandos colligere altera causa fuit.

source: A few days later, at 10 p.m., in Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Trier.
target: Paucis diebus post, hora decima vespertina, in Apartmento 702, 9 Rue Orosai, Quartiere Cathédralis Commémorativæ, Trier.

source: Franca and Jenna glanced at Anthony, who had just knocked and entered, puzzled.
target: Franca et Jenna Antonium conspexerunt, qui modo pulsavit et intravit, perplexus.

source: "Why are you here at this time of day?"
target: "Cur hic es in hoc tempore diei?"

source: Anthony nodded.
target: Antonius annuit.

source: "I’ve found that woman."
target: "Illam mulierem inveni."

source: Huh?
target: "Heu?"

source: Jenna was momentarily surprised before questioning, "The woman who appeared in the Magic Mirror Divination?"
target: Jenna paulisper stupefacta est, deinde interrogavit: "Mulier illa quae in Divinatione Speculi Magici apparuit?"

source: The woman whose presence caused the Mirror World Fragment on me to tremble slightly?
target: Mulier, cuius praesentia fragmentum Mundi Speculi in me leviter tremere faciebat?

source: Anthony affirmed with certainty, "Yes."
target: Antonius certo affirmavit: "Ita."
